intent.proves: Expected nodes/edges for the fixture, variable-only mode omits display-only passthrough inputs but keeps price/BOM/constraint dependencies; changing answers agrees with the engine. Do not assert removed Studio screens. Literal forminput[...] values in defaults or variables create no evaluated edge. Diagram presence is not proof of vendor execution.
intent.scope: Exact declared model/version, catalogue and case set on the target with loaded package and assembly hashes; complete observations only. Missing identity, denied access or truncated scope is UNVERIFIED.
